diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target can be registered before its Lambda invoke permission exists, allowing scheduled invocations to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission granting events.amazonaws.com access to the syncer function.

The EventBridge target can be registered before its Lambda invoke permission exists, allowing scheduled scale-down invocations to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission granting events.amazonaws.com access to the scale-down function.

The EventBridge target can be registered before its Lambda invoke permission exists, allowing scheduled pool invocations to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission granting events.amazonaws.com access to the pool function.

The external GitHub App update can run while the webhook route is not yet configured. The endpoint output refers to the API URL/path but does not establish ordering on this route (or its integration), so the update should wait until the route is created.
The external GitHub App update can run before the API Gateway default stage is provisioned, even though it registers the stage URL. Ensure the updater waits for the stage to exist.
The external GitHub App update can run before API Gateway has permission to invoke the webhook Lambda. The updater should wait for this invoke permission so the registered endpoint is usable.
